metadata.title: ESRI Data Maps Europe,2010
metadata.description: This collection comprises four Shapefile layers from ESRI Data Maps 10 (Europe), distributed with ArcGIS 10. Each layer represents aggregated socioeconomic and demographic information for Europe at a different level of the NUTS (Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics) hierarchy: NUTS 0 (country level), NUTS 1 (major socioeconomic regions, averaging 3–7 million people), NUTS 2 (basic regions for the application of regional policies, averaging 800,000–3,000,000 people), and NUTS 3 (small regions for specific diagnoses, averaging 150,000–800,000 people). Variables include population, demographic, and socioeconomic indicators compiled from Eurostat. For more information on the NUTS classification, see http://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/ramon/nuts/home_regions_en.html.
